description: Sage RAG retrieval evaluation set. Each question maps a realistic clinical query to the guideline document(s) it should surface. 'expected_source' holds document_id(s) from the seeded CLINICAL_DOCUMENTS corpus (services.clinical_knowledge) plus the sample loader corpus (server/corpus/). Used by services.retrieval_eval / scripts/eval_retrieval.py.
